At 4.2V, two resistors each >=99Ω bound current <=21.22mA even treating internal Rcb=0; either input resistor dissipation <=0.0446W. Firmware must stop balancing, wait for two fresh scans, then use voltage for decisions; temperature/current limits and BQ finite balancing timeout remain mandatory. See 检查/AFE内均衡零增件修整说明.md. Pin mapping unchanged; inventory calculation only, no tests. Sources: https://www.ti.com/lit/an/sluaa81a/sluaa81a.pdf ; https://www.oneyac.com/product/27807722.html .

Together with existing 220nF (22us nominal RC), supports optional BQ internal passive fine trim without external FETs/resistors. At 4.2V, two resistors each >=99Ω bound current <=21.22mA even treating internal Rcb=0; either input resistor dissipation <=0.0446W. Enable at most one real cell at a time; cell slots 1..8 and 16 only, mask 0x80FF; never enable shorted VC9..14 or VC15 interval. Active ETA and passive trim must not overlap. Firmware must stop balancing, wait for two fresh scans, then use voltage for decisions; temperature/current limits and BQ finite balancing timeout remain mandatory. See 检查/AFE内均衡零增件修整说明.md. Pin mapping unchanged; inventory calculation only, no tests. Sources: https://www.ti.com/lit/an/sluaa81a/sluaa81a.pdf ; https://www.oneyac.com/product/27807722.html .

raw.备注: SN74LVC74ADR pin mapping unchanged. FF-A: D1=1, CLK1=MAIN_REQ, /PRE1=1, /CLR1=MAIN_CLR_N=BQ_ALERT_IC_N & BMS_LOCAL_OK, Q1=FET_RELEASE. Fault/permit low asynchronously clears main and LOAD_POWER_VALID; recovery needs a fresh MAIN_REQ edge. MCU alone checks precharge voltage and timer completion before requesting main; no independent hardware PRE_OK interlock remains. FF-B: D2=1, CLK2=PRE_REQ, /PRE2=1, /CLR2=POR_OK_N, Q2=TMR_TRIG; one attempt per powered session, only physical OFF/POR rearms. TPL5111 one-shot timing window and U_GATE1 remain. Firmware requires physical OFF after faults, never automatic reclose. ALERT Pin Config 0x92FC=0x82；Default Alarm Mask 0x926D和运行时AlarmEnable 0x66均屏蔽XCHG bit6/XDSG bit5，避免BOTHOFF启动时死锁。保留SSBC bit15、SSA bit14、PF bit13及需要清锁存的真实保护告警；逐项映射OV/UV/OC/SCD/温度及HWDF，读回配置。若此前选中过6/5，先禁用再清旧锁存并确认ALERT解除；真实保护原因须先记录再按恢复策略清除。HWD有限延时；0x9263/0x9267/0x926B bit1启用保护及CHG/DSG动作。DFETOFF 0x92FB=0x42，FET Options 0x9308=0x2D。参考TI TRM https://www.ti.com/lit/ug/sluuby2b/sluuby2b.pdf

raw.备注: Vishay VO617A-2X007T SMD-4 option 7; manufacturer pinout 1=LED A, 2=LED K, 3=phototransistor E, 4=C. Pins 3/4 are a floating external-side positive-logic EN switch: pin4 takes the receiving system's low-current, precharge-available EN bias through its current-limiting resistor; pin3 drives the common LOAD_POWER_VALID EN bus. All receiver ENs must default low with pull-downs to their own PACK-side return. Keep both output pins isolated from B0/CORE_3V3 and use signal-level current only; verify CTR/temperature margin in external design.

raw.备注: 本地默认EN钳位：S=本级BATN B0，D=ETA EN，G=BAL_EN_CLAMP_GATE_1。对应栅极由R_BAL_EN_GATE_PU1拉到本级BATP TAP_B2，VGS为两节电压和（典型5.0–8.4V），低于±12V额定；optocoupler导通时将栅极拉回BATN，MOS关断，ETA内部弱上拉释放EN。厂家Ta=25°C RDS(on)最大值48mΩ的规格点为VGS=2.5V；本应用以EN小电流钳位，首板确认开/关态。 低压控制统一为UMW AO3400A C347475，本级两节差分≤8.4V；原G1/S2/D3网络和电阻保持。IGSS按100nA室温上界估算；门极容量较旧管增大，启动/关断动态仍需首板确认。原厂与官方库依据见检查/小信号MOS统一依据.md。
